versions.content: Support of AUTOSAR Specific Modeling Patterns Type: valid Description: The template for describing profiles for data exchange points shall be able to handle AUTOSAR specific modeling patterns such as • VariationPoints • Splitable • Pseudo Primitive Datatypes (e.g. Identifier, Verbatim String, Limit) • Type / InstanceRef references • Relative references in XML • xml.sequenceOffset • mixed and mixedString • Formulas Rationale: – Use Case: [UC_STDT_00020] Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
